# Sponsor / Track Justification

Track: **AI Trading Desk** - sub-theme **Decision stress-testing**. Domain: tokenized U.S. stocks (Bitget rTokens).

## Bitget Agent Hub (order execution)
- **What we use:** `@bitget-ai/bitget-agent-sdk` 3.3.1 - the Agent Hub catalog/MCP client (`BitgetRestClient.callOperation`, composite tool `strategy_order` to catalog op `placeStrategyOrder`).
- **Where in the code:** `src/adapters/bitget/agenthub.ts` (type import line 21, dynamic `import('@bitget-ai/bitget-agent-sdk')` line 44); invoked from the single order call-site `src/core/executor.ts`.
- **What it does:** the Judge verdict is the only order trigger. A LONG decision routes to a real spot buy via Agent Hub; a SHORT on a spot-only rToken degrades to an honest advisory signal (no fabricated fill).
- **Proof of integration:** `grep -rn "@bitget-ai/bitget-agent-sdk" src` returns the import; `package.json` pins `^3.3.1`.
- **Integration depth:** core - the executor is the end of the decision flow. **Honest note:** live fills require Agentic-Account OAuth; without it the path returns the honest advisory result rather than a fabricated fill (invariant 2).

## Bitget Spot Market API (rToken data)
- **What we use:** Bitget public Spot Market v2 API (`/tickers`, candles).
- **Where in the code:** `src/adapters/bitget/market.ts` (`const BASE = 'https://api.bitget.com/api/v2/spot/market'`, `MarketClient.getCandles` / tickers).
- **What it does:** supplies the point-in-time price context (close, SMA20, ATR14, returns) in every evidence packet and the committed candle series the backtest/forward-return engine reads.
- **Proof of integration:** `grep -rn "api.bitget.com" src` returns the market adapter.
- **Integration depth:** core - no evidence packet exists without it.

## 0G Compute (the reasoning engine)
- **What we use:** 0G Compute Router (`https://router-api.0g.ai/v1`, OpenAI-compatible), model `deepseek-v4-pro`.
- **Where in the code:** `src/adapters/llm/client.ts` (`LLM_BASE_URL`, retry-on-empty); every Bull/Bear/Risk/Judge call runs through it.
- **What it does:** the entire debate IS the live 0G output. Verified end to end on production (evidence -> bull -> bear -> risk -> judge_ruling -> order -> done).
- **Integration depth:** core. **Honest note:** 0G is the decentralized-compute provider, not a Bitget-listed sponsor; it is the engine behind the Agentic-Trading reasoning the brief asks for.

## Not claimed
Bitget Playbook is not integrated. Quorum uses its own committed, leak-safe backtest (`src/core/backtest.ts`) with a per-symbol out-of-sample cutoff guard rather than Playbook's strategy generator.
